ns2:section.sectionText: All seats are reserved for Psychology majors until April 24th. Seniors have Priority on April 5th, Juniors on April 12th and Sophomores on April 17th. An overview of how psychological stress impacts mental and physical health. In this interactive, activity-based (not lecture-based) course, topics to be covered include conceptualization of stress and coping, the biology of the stress response, the role of stress in specific disorders, and stress management interventions
